 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Digital Wallet Product Analytics\n",
    "\n",
    "End-to-end customer and product analytics project using **Python, PostgreSQL, SQL and Power BI**.\n",
    "\n",
    "The dataset is synthetic. Monetary fields are reported in dataset units because no currency is specified.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Setup and data loading\n",
    "\n",
    "Place `digital_wallet_ltv_dataset.csv` in `data/raw/` before running the notebook.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == \"notebooks\" else Path.cwd()\n",
    "DATA_PATH = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"raw\" / \"digital_wallet_ltv_dataset.csv\"\n",
    "PROCESSED_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\"\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / \"outputs\"\n",
    "\n",
    "PROCESSED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n",
    "df.head()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Data quality and exploratory analysis\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "group_columns = [\n",
    "    \"Location\",\n",
    "    \"Income_Level\",\n",
    "    \"App_Usage_Frequency\",\n",
    "    \"Preferred_Payment_Method\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "for column in group_columns:\n",
    "    result = (\n",
    "        df.groupby(column)[\"LTV\"]\n",
    "        .agg([\"count\", \"mean\", \"median\", \"sum\"])\n",
    "        .round(2)\n",
    "        .sort_values(\"mean\", ascending=False)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"\\nLTV по категории: {column}\")\n",
    "    display(result)"
   ]

   "source": [
    "## 3. Feature engineering\n",
    "\n",
    "`Inactivity_Risk` is a rule-based analytical proxy, not a confirmed churn label.\n"
   ]
  },

   "execution_count": 20,
   "id": "947c0b88-a65f-49b0-b12e-8ece920478b9",

   "source": [
    "df[\"Age_Group\"] = pd.cut(\n",

    "    labels=[\"До 25\", \"26-35\", \"36-45\", \"46-55\", \"56-65\", \"66+\"],\n",
    "    include_lowest=True\n",
    ")\n"
   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 4. RFM segmentation\n",
    "\n",
    "Recency, frequency and monetary scores are calculated using quartiles. The final labels are analytical business segments.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 29,
   "id": "3251c73c-c1ea-4bfa-8962-9395d4b2e1da",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df[\"R_Score\"] = pd.qcut(\n",
    "    df[\"Last_Transaction_Days_Ago\"].rank(method=\"first\"),\n",
    "    q=4,\n",
    "    labels=[4, 3, 2, 1]\n",
    ").astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"F_Score\"] = pd.qcut(\n",
    "    df[\"Total_Transactions\"].rank(method=\"first\"),\n",
    "    q=4,\n",
    "    labels=[1, 2, 3, 4]\n",
    ").astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"M_Score\"] = pd.qcut(\n",
    "    df[\"Total_Spent\"].rank(method=\"first\"),\n",
    "    q=4,\n",
    "    labels=[1, 2, 3, 4]\n",
    ").astype(int)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 30,
   "id": "76581a4f-c1eb-4f34-9feb-d2cf16effea8",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df[\"RFM_Code\"] = (\n",
    "    df[\"R_Score\"].astype(str)\n",
    "    + df[\"F_Score\"].astype(str)\n",
    "    + df[\"M_Score\"].astype(str)\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"RFM_Total\"] = (\n",
    "    df[\"R_Score\"]\n",
    "    + df[\"F_Score\"]\n",
    "    + df[\"M_Score\"]\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

    "print(\"Recency:\")\n",
    "print(df[\"R_Score\"].value_counts().sort_index())\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nFrequency:\")\n",
    "print(df[\"F_Score\"].value_counts().sort_index())\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nMonetary:\")\n",
    "print(df[\"M_Score\"].value_counts().sort_index())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 33,
   "id": "dec7e510-2f0c-4e11-84e8-1cb510bdd10a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def assign_rfm_segment(row):\n",
    "    r = row[\"R_Score\"]\n",
    "    f = row[\"F_Score\"]\n",
    "    m = row[\"M_Score\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if r >= 3 and f >= 3 and m >= 3:\n",
    "        return \"Champions\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    elif r <= 2 and (f >= 3 or m >= 3):\n",
    "        return \"High Value at Risk\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    elif r >= 3 and f >= 2:\n",
    "        return \"Loyal\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    elif r >= 3 and f == 1:\n",
    "        return \"Promising\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    elif r <= 2 and f <= 2 and m <= 2:\n",
    "        return \"Hibernating\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        return \"Needs Attention\""
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 34,
   "id": "f8b1bb63-c52f-420d-a0f4-61b2c573b2c7",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df[\"RFM_Segment\"] = df.apply(\n",
    "    assign_rfm_segment,\n",
    "    axis=1\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 5. Retention prioritization\n",
    "\n",
    "The priority score weights LTV by 50%, transaction frequency by 30% and inactivity recency by 20%.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 39,
   "id": "a1e5779b-502d-4a85-9399-3396d28db3cb",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "retention_queue = df[\n",
    "    df[\"RFM_Segment\"] == \"High Value at Risk\"\n",
    "].copy()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 40,
   "id": "f8d95397-ff3a-4f31-bb8a-943ff4b1cb1e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "retention_queue[\"Priority_Score\"] = (\n",
    "    retention_queue[\"LTV\"].rank(pct=True) * 0.5\n",
    "    + retention_queue[\"Total_Transactions\"].rank(pct=True) * 0.3\n",
    "    + retention_queue[\"Last_Transaction_Days_Ago\"].rank(pct=True) * 0.2\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 41,
   "id": "b27a3e99-6551-43d3-a7ef-d64ab5b02f20",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "retention_queue[\"Priority_Level\"] = pd.qcut(\n",
    "    retention_queue[\"Priority_Score\"].rank(method=\"first\"),\n",
    "    q=4,\n",
    "    labels=[\"Low\", \"Medium\", \"High\", \"Critical\"]\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 45,
   "id": "839b12b5-704f-4211-b56b-beff8ec9b5f5",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "retention_queue = retention_queue.sort_values(\n",
    "    \"Priority_Score\",\n",
    "    ascending=False\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "comparison_segments = df[\n",
    "    df[\"RFM_Segment\"].isin(\n",
    "        [\"Champions\", \"High Value at Risk\"]\n",
    "    )\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "segment_comparison = (\n",
    "    comparison_segments\n",
    "    .groupby(\"RFM_Segment\")\n",
    "    .agg(\n",
    "        Customers=(\"Customer_ID\", \"nunique\"),\n",
    "        Average_LTV=(\"LTV\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "        Average_Transactions=(\"Total_Transactions\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "        Average_Spent=(\"Total_Spent\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "        Average_Recency=(\"Last_Transaction_Days_Ago\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "        Average_Active_Days=(\"Active_Days\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "        Average_Satisfaction=(\"Customer_Satisfaction_Score\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "        Average_Support_Tickets=(\"Support_Tickets_Raised\", \"mean\")\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    .round(2)\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "segment_comparison"
   ]
  },

   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "action_mapping = {\n",
    "    \"Critical\": \"Персональное предложение и прямой контакт\",\n",
    "    \"High\": \"Повышенный кешбэк или бонус за возвращение\",\n",
    "    \"Medium\": \"Персональная push- или email-кампания\",\n",
    "    \"Low\": \"Автоматическое напоминание о продукте\"\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "retention_queue[\"Recommended_Action\"] = (\n",
    "    retention_queue[\"Priority_Level\"]\n",
    "    .astype(str)\n",
    "    .map(action_mapping)\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "action_summary = (\n",
    "    retention_queue\n",
    "    .groupby(\n",
    "        [\"Priority_Level\", \"Recommended_Action\"],\n",
    "        observed=True\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    .agg(\n",
    "        Customers=(\"Customer_ID\", \"nunique\"),\n",
    "        Average_LTV=(\"LTV\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "        Total_LTV=(\"LTV\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        Average_Recency=(\"Last_Transaction_Days_Ago\", \"mean\")\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    .round(2)\n",
    "    .reset_index()\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "action_summary"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Interpretation limits\n",
    "\n",
    "- `LTV` and `Total_Spent` have an almost perfect correlation, so using `Total_Spent` to predict `LTV` would create target leakage.\n",
    "- Differences by payment method, app usage, location and income are small and should not be interpreted as causal.\n",
    "- The synthetic dataset has no confirmed churn outcome; inactivity categories are operational heuristics.\n"
   ]
  }
